payload.description: The dependency extras split changed pyproject.toml without regenerating poetry.lock. Clean Poetry installs reject the stale content hash before tests. Poetry 2.3 and 2.4 both enter a multi-minute CPU-bound solve when regenerating the universal lock, so this needs focused resolver or dependency-constraint work. The minimal downstream runtime lock is independently current and unaffected.
payload.title: Regenerate development lock after dependency extras split
